messages:
Mira: CI on main just turned red, lots of failures in `trainer::kv_cache_test` across a few shards. link: https://ci.internal/red/12345
ci-bot: Build 12345 failed on linux-x86-64 (flake count: 14). Re-runs attempted: 1/3. Logs: https://ci.internal/logs/12345
Oliver: ugh, seen that locally too. started a quick grep for suspicious PRs touching kv-cache/alloc code.
Sonia: If it's across shards, could be a scheduling/regression at runtime. Any recent change to allocator or batching?
Mira: There was PR #4628 that tweaked batching heuristics and a tiny allocator change in #4631. Both merged last night.
Priya: I'm +1 to bisect. can someone kick off a git bisect on the last ~20 commits? I can help run local reproducer once we narrow it down.
Jake: I can run CI bisect (binary search with CI runs). It'll take a few hours but should point to the offending commit. Starting now.
ci-bot: Kicking off bisect job: bisect-ci/789 (commits 2a9f..main) — ETA ~3h. Will post candidate commits as it narrows.
Oliver: Thanks. in parallel, i ran a quick local loop and `--seed 42` reproduces failure ~30% of runs, so flaky but consistent enough.
Sonia: Good. once bisect finds candidate, run `git show <sha>` and check for allocator/batching touches. Also check if any test infra changes landed.
Mira: Noted. if it's one of the two PRs above we should prepare a revert PR ready to merge quickly. Priya, can you draft revert for #4628?
Priya: On it. I'll open revert PR `revert-4628` and ping for fast-track review.
ci-bot: bisect-ci/789 narrowed to candidate commit 2a9f7d1 (PR #4628) — failing on 2/3 shards.
Jake: Confirmed locally that reverting 2a9f7d1 makes the test green in repeated runs.
Oliver: Nice. let's hold main deploy. Mira, can you approve the revert once Priya opens it?
Mira: Will do. Also add a note to the rollback runbook to remind ops to hold any automated rollouts until revert passes CI.
Priya: Revert PR opened: https://git.internal/reverts/revert-4628 — includes a quick blurb and test run. tagging @Mira @Oliver for review.
Sonia: Adding a short postmortem checklist on the PR: reproduce steps, flaky reproduction rate, and follow-up task to add a targeted test and increase CI sampling for noisy tests.
Mira: Approved the revert. @deploy-bot please pause merges to main until revert CI passes.
deploy-bot: Merges to main paused by request of Mira. Will resume after revert PR merge and green CI.
Oliver: After revert merges, let's do a targeted perf/regression test for batching heuristics in staging before re-landing with better guardrails.
Mira: Agreed. thanks everyone for the quick triage. I'll write a short incident note and link the revert + bisect outputs.
ci-bot: bisect-ci/789 completed. Culprit: 2a9f7d1 (PR #4628). Full bisect log: https://ci.internal/bisect/789/log
Jake: Follow-up: i'll run a stress job on the revert to make sure we didn't hide a different flaky. will update here.
Mira: Closing the thread after revert merges and one stress run green. Thanks :thumbsup:
